# TabItem

> One tab in a row of tabs. A label, optional icons before and after it, and a green underline when it's the one selected.

## States

`Default` · `Hover` · `Pressed` · `Focus` · `Disabled`

## Anatomy

- `root`: A `<button role="tab">`. Its colour is the label's, and the icons follow it.
- `leading` (optional): A 20px icon. Draw it with `currentColor`.
- `label`
- `trailing` (optional): A 20px icon. Draw it with `currentColor`.
- `underline`: The 2px line along the bottom. Green on the selected tab, a grey hint on an unselected one under the pointer.
- `focus-ring`: Inside the tab, so it never overlaps the next one.

## When to use

- **Views of the same thing.** Switching between views of the same thing, in place: Preview and Code, Overview and Activity.

## When not to use

- **Going to another page.** Going to another page. That's a link, or the nav.
- **On and off.** Turning one thing on and off. That's **Toggle**.

## Behaviour

Always inside **Tabs**, and exactly one is selected. Selecting a tab shows its panel straight away. Hover, pressed and focus come from the browser; selected and disabled are props.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: `<button role="tab">` with `aria-selected` and `aria-controls`, inside a `role="tablist"` that has a name.
- **Name**: the label.
- **Keyboard**: Only the selected tab is in the tab order. Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End go to the first and last.
- **Focus**: the `focus-ring` part, on `:focus-visible`.
- **Icons**: just decoration, `aria-hidden`. The label is the name.

## Content

One or two words, sentence case. The same kind of thing in every tab.
